macro.label: VIX: 15.31
macro.text: S&P 500 at 7,722.72. The VIX held between 16.04 and 16.39 from Monday to Thursday, then fell 6.6% Friday; the S&P 500 ended the week 0.27% lower. With premium a little thinner than midweek, pick the strike first and the dollar amount second.

macro.label: 10-Year Treasury Yield: 5.28%
macro.text: Rose about 0.12 percentage points last week. Utilities and smaller companies tend to move hardest when this rate climbs.

macro.label: Wednesday: 10-year auction and Fed minutes
macro.text: The 10-year Treasury auction lands at 10:00 AM Pacific and the September Fed meeting minutes follow at 11:00 AM Pacific. Don't open a new trade in the hour before either; open it after both are out.

macro.label: Earnings read-throughs: McDonald's, Nike, Lululemon
macro.text: Lamb Weston and Levi's report ahead of Friday, clearing the read-through risk for McDonald's and Lululemon before their calls go on.
